_comment: DEFAULT UI WEIGHTS AND EFFECTS (five-line architecture). Deliberately near-EMPTY: component looks are the Rust drawing code's token defaults, and each scene carries its own layout details in its .scene.json `styles`. Add a key here ONLY for a truly global weight/effect default — never a per-component or per-scene block, and never a `theme` (palette) key. `focus_ring` is one such default: the SECONDARY FOCUS cursor the walker draws around the focused control inside the focused pane (Aaron 2026-09-04) — its colour is the `rune_glow_hi` palette token, these are only its weights.
